description: Read a markdown note's BODY as an addressable list of blocks — headings, paragraphs, list items, task lines, code fences, callouts, tables — each with a `stable_id` you target with patch_note_block, plus `index` (flat position), `depth`/`parent_id` (nesting), `raw` (verbatim markdown) and `is_task`. Also returns the whole-file `content_digest`: pass it back as `expected_digest` so the follow-up write is compare-and-swap guarded (read → digest → write). `frontmatter_raw` is returned for context but is NOT editable through the note-body tools; `is_task_note` flags a TaskNotes task file, whose title update_note refuses to change. Files above 5 MiB are refused.
name: read_note
